comment: Accepted exceptions of tools/check-design-rules.mjs. One entry names one file and one rule, and it states why the rule cannot hold there. Do not add an entry to make a new screen pass.

allow.reason: The theme swatch paints four token values that it reads from the theme registry at run time, one set per family. A utility class names a value at build time, so it cannot express a colour that the registry chooses.
The sandboxed diagram frame writes the SVG that the isolated Mermaid renderer produced. The frame runs on a sandboxed origin, so the markup never reaches the application origin. Decision record 0013.
The undo toast is fixed and centred, so its width must clamp to the smaller of the reading width and the viewport less a gutter: w-[min(28rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]. No named width expresses a clamp.
The shortcut list is a two column grid where the key column is content sized: grid-cols-[1fr_auto]. Tailwind names only equal column counts, so no named value expresses it.
